'''Zeniff''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Genarius]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was a member of the [[Lurid Gundarks]] criminal gang.
